title: Pay trust money into a trust account
what: As a trustee to which the Act applies, keep one or more trust accounts at a financial institution in Queensland and pay all trust money into them.

sources.title: Trust Accounts Act 1973 (Qld)
sources.quote: A trustee shall establish and keep in a financial institution in the State 1 or more trust accounts designated or evidenced as such into which the trustee shall pay all trust moneys
